content:
The next major iPhone software version is iOS 27, and it's coming soon. Here's the expected public release timeline for iOS 27.

iOS 27 will launch in September, likely in the middle of the month

iOS 27 is the next major software update for iPhone, which has been in beta testing throughout the summer.

After several months of beta testing, Apple traditionally rolls out the new major iOS release to all users in September.

Therefore, the expected release date for iOS 27 is in September, estimated to be mid-month.

Here's a look at past iOS release dates from Apple over the last several years:

  • iOS 26: September 15 (Monday)
  • iOS 18: September 16 (Monday)
  • iOS 17: September 18 (Monday)
  • iOS 16: September 12 (Monday)

Based on this pattern, iOS 27 is expected to launch on or around September 14 (Monday).

The official date is typically announced at Apple's annual iPhone event, which usually takes place the week before. iPhone 18 Pro is currently expected to debut on or around September 9.

iOS 27 brings new features for apps like Wallet, Photos, Messages, Notes, as well as upgrades to CarPlay and AirPods, plus major Siri AI revamp and more.

This update will support all the same iPhone models as iOS 26.

What new features and changes in iOS 27 are you most looking forward to? Drop them in the comments.
